svg.title: United States: construction sheet
svg.text: A star’s or sun’s size is the circle through its points, shown dashed.
50 white stars on a grid of 9 rows by 11 columns, in alternate cells from the top left, ~0.8233 apart along the fly and 0.7 down. The
Not measured on this sheet: the vertical variant, the triangle fold.
Sizes in grid units, as the file gives them. A ~ marks a size rounded to four places. The white star’s center is marked +.
